sentences.target: ያለ መጽሐፍ ወደ ትምህርት ቤት አልሄድም።
sentences.text: I do not go to school without a book.
In Addis Ababa, January is cold.
I have a birthday in February.
In March there is a lot of wind.
In May the road is wet.
In June there is a lot of rain.
In June the grass is green.
In July an umbrella is necessary.
In August the harvest is ready.
In August the day is long.
In October the dry season starts.
In October the weather is good.
There is a holiday in October.
In November warm clothes are needed.
There is a road to the south.
The sun rises from the east.
There is a window toward the east.
The east is bright in the morning.
The sun sets toward the west.
The west looks red in the evening.
There is a mountain toward the west.
A new bridge has been built.
On Sunday I go to church.
A bell is heard from the church.
On Friday I go to the mosque.
The mosque is near the square.
There is a market in the square.
I go to the factory by bus.
I bring a document to the government office.
The government office opens in the morning.
I have an appointment at the government office.
There is a picture on the page.
The price of bread has risen.
Do not forget the appointment time.
The appointment is at the clinic.
There is a light in the room.
The glasses are on the table.
I have taken a photo with a camera.
I hear sound from the radio.
The address is on the document.
I have sent mail to a friend.
I gave a gift for the birthday.
On a holiday we are together as a family.
A holiday is a rest day.
The leaf has a bitter taste.
The market is a loud place.
